items.title: Bosonic Fock number operator and counting PVM
items.statement: Defines the bosonic Fock number operator, its domain, and candidate sector projections; the local theorem proves self-adjointness and the PVM clauses.

references.title: Mark Srednicki, Quantum Field Theory, author-hosted 2006 prepublication book draft, §55 “Electrodynamics in Coulomb Gauge,” printed pp. 335–338

items.title: The Fock number operator has its sector counting PVM
items.statement: Proves the Fock number operator is self-adjoint and its sector projections form a strongly countably additive PVM and finite projective partitions.

references.title: Mark Srednicki, Quantum Field Theory, author-hosted 2006 prepublication book draft, §55 “Electrodynamics in Coulomb Gauge,” printed pp. 335–338

items.title: Regulated soft coherent photon-count prediction
items.statement: For a fixed massive charge-flow current and finite energy cutoffs, gives the conditional coherent photon-count law, expected energy, and zero-cutoff ray result under the adopted finite Born interpretation.

references.title: David Tong, Quantum Field Theory, author-hosted complete lecture notes, Chapter 6, §§6.2.1–6.2.2
Mark Srednicki, Quantum Field Theory, author-hosted 2006 complete prepublication book draft, §§54–56
Roy J. Glauber, “Coherent and Incoherent States of the Radiation Field,” Physical Review 131 (1963), 2766–2788, §§II–III and IX

items.physical_scope: Fixed finite massive prescribed charge-flow current, measurable transverse polarizations, and finite photon-energy cutoffs 0 < lambda < Lambda. The result is the exact count distribution and mean energy of the constructed normalized positive-free-photon coherent state under the adopted finite projective Born interpretation. For positive angular coefficient the zero-cutoff family has no Fock-vector or projective-ray limit despite bounded mean energy. No interacting-QED scattering event, detector response, or empirical observation is asserted.

title: Regulated soft coherent photon-count prediction — Examples

items.title: One-charge soft photon count example
items.statement: Specializes the prescribed one-charge free coherent-state prediction to v=1/2 and lambda=Lambda/e.
items.physical_scope: An exact numerical specialization of the prescribed-current positive free coherent-state model and finite-cutoff photon-count prediction. It describes a prepared model state, not an observed or simulated emission event.

items.title: Fan2022 reported electron magnetic-moment determination
items.statement: Records the authors’ apparatus, analysis, reported eleven-field weighted estimate, stated uncertainty, and correlation limitations.

references.title: X. Fan et al., Measurement of the Electron Magnetic Moment, Physical Review Letters 130, 071801 (2023), arXiv:2209.13084v2 (2022)

items.physical_scope: The source-reported 2022 one-electron cryogenic Penning-trap determination, including alternating quantum-jump trials, fitted and corrected frequencies, eleven weighted field determinations, and cavity and broadening analysis. The raw trials, covariance matrix, and weights are not reconstructed here.

items.title: Qualified reported anomaly by exact affine subtraction
items.statement: Subtracts the exact reference 1 from the reported ratio and carries its stated uncertainty and empirical qualifications.

references.title: X. Fan et al., Measurement of the Electron Magnetic Moment, Physical Review Letters 130, 071801 (2023), arXiv:2209.13084v2 (2022)

items.physical_scope: Exact affine derivation from the 2022 reported one-electron Penning-trap estimate. The anomaly inherits the source's apparatus, correction, 11-field weighting, stated 1 sigma uncertainty, correlation caveat, and omitted-data limitations; no theory comparison or new statistical inference is made.

empirical_premises.conditions: Reported 2022 one-electron cryogenic Penning-trap determination using alternating quantum-jump spectroscopy, fitted and corrected frequencies, eleven weighted field determinations, and cavity/broadening analysis; raw trials, covariance matrix, and weights are not reconstructed here.
empirical_premises.uncertainty: Authors state a 1 sigma uncertainty of 1.3e-13 in the dimensionless ratio; nearby-field cavity uncertainties are correlated. No Gaussian, independent, posterior, or coverage interpretation is added.
empirical_premises.use: Subtract the exact reference value 1 from the source-reported ratio. The affine shift preserves the reported deviation and stated uncertainty; no theory comparison is inferred.
